stemMarkdown: In a survey of 175 people, 113 like tea and 61 like coffee, while 31 like neither. How many like both tea and coffee?
solutionMarkdown: People liking at least one drink: $175 - 31 = 144$. By inclusion-exclusion, $|A \cup B| = |A| + |B| - |A \cap B|$, so $|A \cap B| = 113 + 61 - 144 = 30$.
